source_occurrences.text: Eduardo Garduño | garduno@deforest.mx | 1999 | Eduardo is the Partner of DeForest’s Labor & Employment practice and one of the most respected voices in labor governance in Mexico. His background blends more than two decades advising multinational employers with senior public-sector experience, allowing him to translate complex regulatory environments into stable operational frameworks. He is known for structuring policies and documentation systems that support high-risk, labor-intensive operations, as well as for steering high-value disputes that require strategic judgement and procedural precision. His leadership extends across mandates involving litigation coordination, cross-state governance and preventive frameworks for clients such as Volkswagen, Cinemex, GeNi, Scheaffler, Benteler, SKF and Megacable.

The department is led by one of the country's most experienced labor teams. Eduardo Garduño has become one of Mexico's leading labor strategists for multinational employers, combining more than two decades of experience advising major corporations with senior public-sector insight that enables him to translate complex regulatory environments into practical business solutions.

Javier Atzin Vallejo | vallejo@deforest.mx | 2019 | Javier is a technical specialist whose practice sits at the intersection of labor law, social security and regulatory compliance. His experience includes conducting complex audits, harmonising documentation across multi-plant structures and advising on labor components of acquisitions and restructurings. Known for his precise analytical approach, Javier is essential in mandates requiring meticulous documentation, accurate risk assessment and alignment with global corporate standards. His work is particularly relevant for industrial, infrastructure and advanced-manufacturing groups.

The leadership team is further strengthened by Javier Atzin Vallejo, whose practice focuses on labor compliance, social security and workforce integration; Edgar Barreto, recognised for his experience in labor litigation and IMSS matters; Andrés Cabrera, who leads the firm's labor practice across the Bajío region; Erick Pérez, a specialist in complex litigation and constitutional proceedings; and José Alberto Díaz, whose practice combines labor, social security and administrative litigation in highly regulated industries.

Jaime Bustamante, Raymundo Carreño, Javier Atzin Vallejo, Edgar Barreto, Andrés Cabrera, Erick Pérez and José Alberto Díaz. | Leading labor and employment practice with strong capabilities in both advisory and contentious matters. The team is known for its technical rigor, hands-on approach, and ability to handle complex, high-impact mandates, making it a trusted advisor for both domestic and multinational clients.

Jaime Bustamante | bustamante@deforest.mx | 2022 | Jaime brings the perspective of someone who has managed labor structures on a global scale. Before joining DeForest, he served as Legal Director for Mexico, Central and South America at ManpowerGroup, overseeing one of the largest employer workforces in the region. This experience shapes his approach to complex disputes, mass-litigation management, workforce transitions and collective bargaining negotiations in high-pressure environments. His influence extends into national policy circles through his role as Vice President of the labor, Social Security and HR Commission at CONCAMIN, reinforcing his standing as a reference point for employers navigating regulatory reform, cross-border HR structures and large-scale labor exposure.

Andrés Cabrera Gómez | cabrera@deforest.mx | 2023 | Andrés leads the firm’s practice in the Bajío region, one of Mexico’s most active industrial corridors. He is recognised for his ability to execute litigation strategies with speed, clarity and sensitivity to local dynamics—particularly in jurisdictions adapting to the post-reform judicial system. His work bridges the strategic frameworks designed by senior partners with the practical realities of implementation in critical regions. For many clients, Andrés provides the on-the-ground coordination that ensures consistency across the firm’s national approach.

Raymundo Carreño | carreno@deforest.mx | 2016 | With nearly forty years at Volkswagen de México, including his tenure as General Legal Director, Raymundo embodies an uncommon depth of experience in corporate labor relations. He has played a central role in major regulatory transitions, high-stakes union negotiations and organisational restructurings that have defined the automotive sector in Mexico. His judgement is sought in matters where legal interpretation intersects with operational continuity and corporate strategy. His presence within the practice adds a level of senior insight that few labor teams in the country can access.

Raymundo Carreño brings the institutional knowledge accumulated during nearly four decades as General Legal Director of Volkswagen de México, offering clients strategic judgement developed through some of the country's most significant labor negotiations and organisational transformations.
